name: ump
description: Google User Messaging Platform (GDPR / US privacy consent form, IAB TCF v2.2) for Android and iOS. Protocol: consent (docs/plugins.md, engine/services/Consent.h). Config: appId (AdMob / Ad Manager app id, needed by UMP: per platform), testDevices [hashed device ids printed by the SDK], underAge (tag for users under the age of consent).
